name: appkit
description: The zinc:ui tree shown with real AppKit views under "ui": {"render": "native"} (macOS): View, Text, Image, ScrollView, TextInput, TextArea and Pressable as NSViews, measured by AppKit, in the system colours; Window, Toolbar, SplitView and Sidebar as the window's own chrome; Table and Outline as NSTableView and NSOutlineView
